name: Classic Margherita Pizza
directions: Heat the oven as hot as it goes.
Stretch the dough and spread the sauce.
Add the mozzarella and bake until the crust is crisp.
Top with basil.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
directions: Marinate the chicken in yogurt and spices.
Grill the chicken until charred.
Simmer the tomatoes with spices, add cream and the chicken.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
directions: Boil the spaghetti until al dente.
Warm the garlic and chili in the olive oil.
Toss the spaghetti with the oil and parsley.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
directions: Soften the onion.
Add tomatoes and stock and simmer.
Blend with the basil.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
directions: Boil the linguine.
Cook the garlic and shrimp in olive oil until pink.
Toss with the pasta and lemon.

name: Pasta Arrabbiata
directions: Boil the pasta until al dente.
Fry garlic and chili in olive oil, then add the tomato sauce.
Toss the pasta in the sauce.

name: Caribbean Jerk Chicken
directions: Rub the chicken with seasoning and lime.
Grill until cooked through.
